gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-batak: Expressive, tube-bent letters from Funnel Display lead, then Noto Sans Batak takes over with a stubby, towering lowercase. Its e never squeezes shut, which keeps the whole thing approachable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-benga: Commanding rounded strokes, like cut lengths of cord, carry Funnel Display from the first letter. But Noto Sans Bengali settles in with distinctly open letter mouths, a contemporary sans-serif softness beside that firmness.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-bhaik: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads plump and friendly, its lowercase swollen like coiled rope. Funnel Display does the shouting with zero stroke contrast, while the body does the quiet, readable work.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-brahm: Contemporary open-ended curves mark Noto Sans Brahmi, with its mean line set high. What stands out most is the total lack of contrast between stems and joins in Funnel Display, a commanding tubular line.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid reads modern, with curve ends held well off the stem. Paragraphs set in it should feel unhurried and tidy, while Funnel Display keeps its neon-tube consistency up top.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-caria: Funnel Display runs without any stroke modulation, while Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades. One feels forceful, the other clean and quietly precise.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-chakm: A single line weight, bent like spaghetti, defines Funnel Display, and Noto Sans Chakma tucks its lowercase up toward the caps. Its strength is approachable openness against all that force.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-cham: Marker-tip boldness runs through Funnel Display, each stroke uniform in width and each c tip kept apart. Noto Sans Cham brings tall, rounded lowercase and generous entry space, a modern, clean counterweight.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-chero: No hairlines ever appear in Funnel Display, whose spaghetti-like strokes hold one width throughout. Noto Sans Cherokee gives that heading a tall, orderly band of letters beneath it, with a wide gap at the e's terminal.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-chora: Noto Sans Chorasmian stops its curves short instead of closing them, with a large x-height, short ascenders. Noto Sans Chorasmian sits quietly under Funnel Display, whose strokes never swell or thin.
